title: fix(plugin-list): an empty gallery draws the grid empty state, translated (objectui#12217)
body:
Fixes #12217
Clause-②: no

An empty gallery now draws the same empty state an empty grid draws: the view's authored `emptyState` (`title` and `message` resolved against the display locale, its `icon`), otherwise the localized `list.*` copy. It used to draw a hard-coded English "No items to display" in every locale and ignored the authored `emptyState`.

## What changed

- **One shared component, `ListEmptyState`** (new, module-internal: `packages/plugin-list/src/ListEmptyState.tsx`, not in the package barrel). The grid's inline empty-state block in `ListView` moved into it unchanged: the copy selection between the user's query, the view filter and first run (objectui#4155, objectui#11687), the `I18nLabel` resolution of `title` and `message` (objectui#11227), the `Inbox` glyph fallback, and the add-record action. No second string table, no new key.
- **`ListView`** draws it for `gallery` as it does for `grid` (the empty branch's condition is now grid or gallery). The authored icon name is still resolved through `resolveIcon` inside `ListView`, and the component takes the resolved glyph. So `ListView.tsx` still calls the icon seam, which `scripts/__tests__/check-lucide-icon-record-names.test.ts` pins by path, and the change stays inside the claimed file surface.
- **`ObjectGallery`**'s empty branch draws it standalone, through the translation hook `ListView` draws it with (`useListViewTranslation`, now a module-level export of `ListView.tsx`; the barrel does not re-export it) and `useDisplayLocale()`.

## H1: the two paths a gallery reaches, and the cloud page

| Path | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Under `ListView` with `viewType: 'gallery'`: the console's object list (`app-shell` `ObjectView` hands `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView` a `renderListView` that mounts `ListView`) and an interface list page whose visualization is a gallery | `ListView`'s empty branch was grid-only, so the empty list went through `SchemaRenderer` to `ObjectGallery`, which drew the English line | `ListView` draws `ListEmptyState` itself; `ObjectGallery` is not mounted for an empty list |
| Standalone: an authored `object-gallery` node, `plugin-view` `ObjectView`'s own non-grid path (no `renderListView`), `RelatedList`'s mobile card list | `ObjectGallery` drew the English line | `ObjectGallery` draws `ListEmptyState` |

**The cloud page 「高级 → 我的软件包」 takes the `ListView` path.** It is a `type: 'list'` page (cloud's `sys-package.page.ts`, as objectstack-ai/objectstack#23005's evidence states), rendered by `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `InterfaceListPage`, which mounts `ListView` with `viewType` taken from `appearance.allowedVisualizations[0]`. This is read from source and was not measured on the cloud console: the cloud repository is not attached to this session. That page relays its own `filter` (`publisher = 'private'`) and has no page-level `emptyState` to relay (the spec gap objectstack-ai/objectstack#23005). So it will draw the view-filter wording the grid draws on the same page: in zh 「没有匹配的记录」 / 「没有符合该视图筛选条件的记录。」.

`RelatedList` draws no card body while its list is empty (its `!isEmpty` guard), so its mobile gallery reaches the empty branch only in edge windows.

## H2: what each caller can see

| Input | `ListView` | `ObjectGallery` standalone |
|---|---|---|
| authored `emptyState` | `schema.emptyState` (title, message, icon) | none: `ObjectGallerySchema` declares no `emptyState`, and adding it is a type change this card rules out |
| view filter (`hasBaseFilter`) | the resolved view `filter` | its own `filter`, only when the gallery issued the query itself (`fetchesForItself`); rows a host handed in were filtered by the host |
| user query (`hasUserQuery`) | search box, user-filter chips, filter panel | none (`false`) |
| add-record action | `toolbarFlags.showAddRecord` | none: the gallery has no such control |
| translation and locale | `useListViewTranslation`, `useDisplayLocale` | the same two hooks |

Chosen shape: `ListView` draws the shared component for `gallery` as it does for `grid`. That is the simplest correct shape, and `ListView` holds every input. `ObjectGallery` draws the component standalone with what it knows. The filter predicate is the shared `hasDeclaredFilter`, so the two callers cannot disagree about what a non-empty filter is.

## H3: i18n

The copy uses the six `list.*` keys the grid already read: `list.noMatches`, `list.firstRunTitle`, `list.noMatchesMessage`, `list.viewFilterNoMatchesMessage`, `list.firstRunMessage` and `list.addRecord`. All six sit under `list` in the built-in `zh` pack, and the provider-less fallback is `LIST_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`. `ObjectGallery` reaches them through `ListView`'s own `useListViewTranslation`. No key is added; `pnpm check:i18n-keys` is green.

## H4: other view types' empty branches (measured, not changed)

These are cited by file and quoted text, because AGENTS.md rule #11 bans line addresses in a pull-request body.

- **kanban**, `packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx`: the board-level `DataEmptyState` reads `t('kanban.noCards')`. It is localized, but it does not read the view's authored `emptyState`.
- **calendar**, `packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx`: there is no empty-state copy; an empty calendar draws its grid.
- **timeline**, `packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx`: there is no empty-state copy. The loading placeholder carries a hard-coded English screen-reader line, `Loading timeline…`.
- **gantt**, `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` and `GanttView.tsx`: there is no empty-state copy; an empty chart draws its axis.
- **map**, `packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx`: there is no empty-state copy over a working map. The WebGL-failure fallback list draws hard-coded English `No locations to list.`, beside the hard-coded failure sentence that starts `Map failed to load`.
- **tree**, `packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx`: an empty tree draws hard-coded English `No records` (and `Loading…` while loading), although `useTreeTranslation` is in scope in that component.
- **chart**, `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx`: a localized `DataEmptyState` through `dashboard.empty.title` (inline default `No data yet`).

## Tests and gates (all at `d7f71fd`, this branch's head)

- **New pins**, `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ObjectGallery.emptyState-12217.test.tsx`, 10 rows:
  - Under `ListView`: zh first-run copy and the zh add-record label; an authored inline locale map painting its zh-CN entries; an authored plain string drawn as written; and the gallery and the grid drawing the same empty state node for node.
  - Standalone: zh first-run copy; built-in English copy with no add-record action; the view-filter wording when its own `filter` emptied its own query; and a no-filter control.
  - Two positive controls prove the gallery really is the visualization mounted.
- **Reverse verification.** `ListView.tsx` and `ObjectGallery.tsx` were checked out at the base `a491b64` (hash-equal to the base blobs; on disk `No items to display` = 1 and `ListEmptyState` = 0 in `ListView.tsx`). The new file then ran **8 failed, 2 passed**: the eight rows that need the fix went red and the two controls stayed green, the direction predicted. Both paths were restored from `HEAD` under a trap and are hash-equal to the `HEAD` blobs, with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Controls the card names**, unchanged and green: `ListView.emptyVsErrorRole-7132`, `ListView.emptyStateFilteredCopy` (objectui#4155, objectui#11687 rows), `ListView.emptyStateI18nLabel-11227` and `icon-seam-fallbacks-5935`.
- **Targeted vitest**, run from the repository root:
  - 40 `plugin-list` files (every `ObjectGallery` test, every `ListView` empty-state test, the gallery-touching `ListView` tests): `Test Files 40 passed (40)`, `Tests 457 passed (457)`.
  - 38 files outside the package that read `ListView.tsx` / `ObjectGallery.tsx` source or render a gallery through them. These include the `InterfaceListPage` relay census, the lucide icon census, the `ObjectView` gallery tests, `RelatedList`'s mobile gallery and the `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack` gate: `Test Files 38 passed (38)`, `Tests 845 passed (845)`.
  - The existing `ObjectGallery.fetchGate-7903` negative assertion asserted on the old English string, so it would have passed for nothing. It now looks for the shared component's test id instead.
- **Builds and type-check.** The dependency closure was built with `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-list^...'` (12/12). `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list run type-check` echoed `type-check` and ran both `tsc` projects, exit 0. `tsconfig.test.json`'s file list includes the new test.
- **Published face.** `dist/index.d.ts` names none of `ListEmptyState`, `useListViewTranslation` or `hasDeclaredFilter`, and neither `src/index.tsx` nor `package.json` changed. The per-file declarations gain `ListEmptyState.d.ts`, and `ListView.d.ts` now exports `useListViewTranslation`. The `exports` map exposes only the package root, so neither is reachable through it.
- **Gates, exit 0:** `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check-changeset-presence` (5 source files of 1 released package, 1 changeset), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations). The derived gates are green too: `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape` and `check:handler-key-reads`.
- **Lint, narrowed and declared.** eslint ran with the repository config on the 5 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files (count read from `--format json`): 0 errors. The config extends `tseslint.configs.recommended` with no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The full `eslint .` run is CI's.
- **NOT MEASURED** (each needs a console or all-package build this container did not make; CI runs them):
  - `check:readme-exports`: 386 self-imports unjudged because packages are unbuilt.
  - `check:eager-closure`: no `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`. The console aliases `@object-ui/plugin-list` to its `src`, whose barrel already imports both `ListView` and `ObjectGallery`, so the new `ObjectGallery` to `ListView` edge adds no module to any closure; `ListEmptyState.tsx` is moved code.
  - `check:sdui-registration-pins`: no console build. The `object-gallery` registration is unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **Standalone galleries have no authored empty copy to show.** `ObjectGallerySchema` declares no `emptyState`, and `plugin-view` `ObjectView`'s own path (no `renderListView`) relays a named view's `emptyState` to no visualization, its grid included. Only its `renderListView` branch relays it. Not changed here: either half is a type or relay change outside this card.
- **The tree's `No records` and the map's `No locations to list.` are the same untranslated-empty-copy family as this card.** They are listed in H4. Neither is filed here, and neither was measured at a public door.
- **Docs.** No page under `content/docs` or `packages/plugin-list/README.md` describes the list's empty-state copy, so nothing went stale.
